'''Tidjane Salaün''' (born 10 August 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Cholet Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]].

==Professional career==
Salaün began playing for [[Cholet Basket]]'s team in LNB Espoirs, the French under-21 league, in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/cholet/basket-leray-dufeal-salaun-bordes-la-vie-dapres-des-espoirs-de-cholet-c9da9044-fdfd-11ed-a6e9-8b0f9ca2841f | title=Basket. Leray, Dufeal, Salaun, Bordes… la vie d'après des Espoirs de Cholet|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=30 May 2023|access-date=16 October 2023|language=French}}</ref> Salaün participated in the NBA [[Basketball Without Borders]] camp during the [[2023 NBA All-Star Game|2023 NBA All-Star weekend]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-frances-tidjane-salaun|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: France's Tidjane Salaun|website=[[SI.com]]|date=2 October 2023|access-date=16 October 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/cholet/basket-le-choletais-tidjane-salaun-invite-par-la-nba-a-un-camp-reunissant-40-talents-internationaux-2c1f251a-a897-11ed-aeeb-69381795ad8f|title=Basket. Le Choletais Tidjane Salaun invité par la NBA à un camp réunissant 40 talents internationaux|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=9 February 2023|access-date=1 December 2023|language=French}}</ref> Salaün was named the MVP of the 2023 Trophée du Futur (Trophy of the Future) tournament after averaging 17.7 points and 7.3 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lanouvellerepublique.fr/blois/trophee-du-futur-a-blois-tidjane-salaun-a-amorce-son-decollage|title=Trophée du Futur : à Blois, Tidjane Salaun a amorcé son décollage|first=Mateo|last=Dufour|work=[[La Nouvelle République du Centre-Ouest]]|date=28 May 2023|access-date=1 December 2023|language=French}}</ref>

Salaün signed his first professional contract with Cholet's senior team on 10 July 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ouest-france.fr/sport/basket/cholet/basket-cholet-basket-signe-pro-sa-pepite-tidjane-salaun-il-sera-la-rotation-du-poste-3-6ce407f0-1f43-11ee-990b-509b31c26799|title=Basket. Cholet Basket signe pro sa pépite Tidjane Salaun : « Il sera la rotation du poste 3 »|work=[[Ouest-France]]|date=10 July 2023|access-date=16 October 2023|language=French}}</ref>

==National team career==
Salaün played for the [[France men's national under-19 basketball team|France national under-18 team]] in the [[2023 FIBA U18 European Championship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/La-france-eliminee-par-l-espagne-en-demi-finales-de-l-euro-u18/1410920|title=La France éliminée par l'Espagne en demi-finales de l'Euro U18|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=29 July 2023|access-date=1 December 2023|language=French}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Salaün's parents both played basketball. His sister, {{ill|Janelle Salaün|fr}}, plays in the [[EuroLeague Women]] and for the [[France women's national basketball team]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=French teen Tidjane Salaun submits paperwork to enter NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40022074/french-teen-tidjane-salaun-submits-paperwork-enter-nba-draft |website=ESPN |access-date=27 May 2024 |date=25 April 2024}}</ref>
